h-veteran.name: First Blade (veteran)
h-veteran.role: hunter crew, steps 4-5 (the crew scaled to the step)

g-veteran.name: Skyglass Sentinel (veteran)
g-veteran.role: gatherer crew, steps 4-5 (the crew scaled to the step)

wound.desc: Torn on a snare: you bleed with every action

poison.desc: An old bait vial bursts: chakra and stamina you spend burn as poison

moveprevent.desc: A line around the ankle: you cannot move

decreasemaxpools.desc: Cold eyes / crystal in the lungs: your maximum health is lowered

elementalseal.desc: Dust in the seal channels: your elemental jutsu are sealed

increasepoolcost.desc: The growth drinks chakra: your jutsu cost more

afterburn.desc: A cut channel flares: damage you take burns again

bone.character: lockers early, a cheap but dangerous start

bloom.character: heavy dust hazards, a steep tier curve

rot.name: Rot-soaked
rot.effect: every hazard doubled; every chest one tier higher (+40% bonus chest each)

flood.name: Flooded hold
flood.effect: rooted (moveprevent) for the first 3 rounds of every fight (2 on gatherer pages, RUL-2026-10-29-045); lockers carry no hazard; chests one tier higher (+40% bonus chest)

alarmed.name: Alarmed
alarmed.effect: start at alertness 2; lockers offered at every step from 4 and worth more; chests one tier higher (+40% bonus chest each)

picked.name: Picked clean
picked.effect: easier fights (the previous step's guards, no crate or alertness hazards); chests one tier lower, each at 60%

copyRules.g-canister: set charge: stationary, Core Rupture adjacent (<= 0) or fuse round 5
